notes.title: BOMBFEST 1.01 Update!
notes.content:
We've got an update for you today, friends! Plenty of bug fixes to improve your experience. Check out the changes below:

[list]
[*] AI may no longer earn achievements for you
[*] Fixed unlocking Ice Bomb twice
[*] Fixed Cotton Swap not OHKOing when players are at max damage
[*] Fixed Setup Menu overlapping itself when first opened
[/list]

Let us know what you think, and good luck with those achievements!

notes.title: BOMBFEST is BACK on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Friends![/h1]

You can get a Steam key for the game, as well as some cool rewards like a [b]limited-edition t-shirt, your own BOMBFEST wooden toys,[/b] or the opportunity to [b]design your own character and bomb![/b] At the $30 tier, you can join our [b]closed beta[/b] team and play the game before launch, too! Consider backing the game and helping us drum up some funds for a successful launch!
